title: Measures of Central Tendency
code:
Mean (μ) = Σxᵢ / n  (sum over i = 1 to n)
Median: The middle value of a dataset (for an ordered set)
Mode: The most frequent value in a dataset

title: Measures of Dispersion
code:
Variance (σ²) = Σ(xᵢ - μ)² / n  (sum over i = 1 to n)
Standard Deviation (σ) = √(Variance)
Range = Max - Min

title: Probability
code:
Probability of an event: P(E) = (Number of favorable outcomes) / (Total number of possible outcomes)
Complement Rule: P(E') = 1 - P(E)
Addition Rule: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B)
Multiplication Rule: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) · P(B|A)

title: Probability Distributions
code:
Binomial Distribution: P(X = k) = nCk · pᵏ · (1 - p)^(n-k)
Normal Distribution: P(X) = [1 / (σ√(2π))] · e^(-(X - μ)²/(2σ²))

title: Hypothesis Testing
code:
Null Hypothesis (H₀): The hypothesis stating no effect or no difference.
Alternative Hypothesis (H₁): The hypothesis stating there is an effect or difference.
Test Statistic (z): z = (X - μ) / (σ/√n)
p-value: The probability of observing a result at least as extreme as the result obtained, under the null hypothesis.

title: Correlation and Regression
code:
Pearson's Correlation Coefficient: r = (nΣxy - ΣxΣy) / √[(nΣx² - (Σx)²)(nΣy² - (Σy)²)]
Simple Linear Regression Equation: Y = a + bX, where a = intercept, b = slope

title: Confidence Interval
code:
Confidence Interval: μ ± Z · (σ/√n)
where Z is the Z-score corresponding to the confidence level.
